Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the search results and conflated Lion Air (Indonesian carrier) with Thai Lion Air, incorrectly concluding its primary hub is Don Mueang (Bangkok, Thailand). The visible results pointed to Indonesian airports (e.g., Soekarno–Hatta, Juanda), which would lead to Indonesia and its former name, Dutch East Indies. This premature, unsupported assumption led to the wrong final answer (“Siam”).
